data.long_description:
Sobha Creek Vistas Heights is the latest addition to Sobha Realty’s portfolio, featuring two magnificent towers, Tower A and Tower B, with top-of-the-line finishes. Perfectly positioned near the bustling Downtown Dubai, these towers offer the last residential opportunities in Sobha Hartland with breathtaking views of Downtown and the Burj Khalifa. The development offers a selection of 1-3 bedroom apartments, each equipped with fully-fitted kitchens and wardrobes.

Sobha Creek Vistas Heights is developed by Sobha Realty, a premium developer based in Dubai, renowned for its exceptional residential projects such as One Park Avenue and Waves Grande.

Situated in the sought-after community of Sobha Hartland, the strategic location of Creek Vistas Heights offers residents easy access to various facilities and well-developed infrastructure, including:
Green areas
Retail shops
Restaurants
Educational institutions

  Sobha Creek Vistas Heights combines luxurious living with convenience, making it an ideal choice for those looking to experience the best of Dubai.
